The '''Rapid Recon Walker''' was a two-legged combat [[Walker/Legends|walker]] in use during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and the later [[War against Zakuul|revolt]] against the [[Eternal Empire]] by the future [[Eternal Alliance]]. The walker was armed with a chin-mounted [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] as well as two smaller dual laser cannons mounted on either side of the driver compartment.<ref name="TOR" />

The walker saw extensive use as a patrol and recon vehicle but was also used as a main combat force for anti-personnel roles.

Many were also modified to bolster heavier weapons and armor, making the walker more able to fight for an extended duration of time and to greater effect.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rapid Recon Walker was made available on [[December 2]], [[2016]] as one of the pre-order rewards for the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion. Players who held a premium subscription for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[November 27]], 2016 were given access to the Rapid Recon Walker mount in game.<ref name="">{{TORweb|url=eternal-throne|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne}}</ref>
